## Objective


```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

mucosa_list_new  <- fromJSON( "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box//judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/mucosa_list_all.json") %>%
  distinct()

problem_segments <- mucosa_list_new %>%
  filter(classification == "too_small")

problem_fragments <- unique(problem_segments$image_fragment_name)
problem_images <- unique(problem_segments$image_name)

new_versions <- mucosa_list_new %>% filter(image_name %in% problem_images)

mucosa_list_old <- fromJSON( "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box//judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/mucosa_metadata_batch_2_to_6.json") %>%
  mutate(image_fragment_name = paste(image_name, fragment_name, sep = "_"))  %>%
  distinct()

old_versions <- mucosa_list_old %>% filter(image_name %in% problem_images)


new_versions <- new_versions %>% filter(image_name %in% old_versions$image_name)

new_fragments_in_old<- new_versions %>% filter(image_fragment_name %in% old_versions$image_fragment_name)

old_fragments_in_new <- old_versions %>% filter(image_fragment_name %in% new_versions$image_fragment_name)

identical_obs <- intersect(new_fragments_in_old, old_fragments_in_new)

differing_obs <- setdiff(new_fragments_in_old, old_fragments_in_new) %>%
  bind_rows(setdiff(old_fragments_in_new, new_fragments_in_old))
```


```{r}
library(fs)
mucosa_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/fragment_quality_suite/mucosa/output/mucosa/"

file_info_mucosa <- dir_info(path = mucosa_dir, type = "file")

# Show only file name and creation time
file_list_mucosa <- file_info_mucosa[, c("path", "modification_time")]

# Optional: simplify to just file name
file_list_mucosa$file <- path_file(file_list_mucosa$path)
file_list_mucosa <- file_list_mucosa[, c("file", "modification_time")] %>%
    mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = if_else(
    str_ends(file, "_mucosa.geojson"),
    str_remove(file, "_mucosa\\.geojson$"),
    NA_character_
  ))

map_to_mucosa_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_models/merge_model_output/map_to_mucosa/output/map_to_mucosa/"

file_info_map_to_mucosa <- dir_info(path = map_to_mucosa_dir, type = "file")

# Show only file name and creation time
file_list_map_to_mucosa <- file_info_map_to_mucosa[, c("path", "modification_time")]

# Optional: simplify to just file name
file_list_map_to_mucosa$file <- path_file(file_list_map_to_mucosa$path)
file_list_map_to_mucosa  <- file_list_map_to_mucosa [, c("file", "modification_time")] %>%
    mutate(image_fragment_mucosa_name = if_else(
    str_ends(file, "_fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2_mapped_to_mucosa.geojson"),
    str_remove(file, "_fe_si_combos_pv2_mv2_mapped_to_mucosa\\.geojson$"),
    NA_character_
  )) %>%
  filter(!is.na(image_fragment_mucosa_name))
```

```{r}
mucosa_list_included <- mucosa_list_new %>%
  filter(orientation_class == "adequate" | orientation_class == "marginal") %>%
  filter(artefact_class == "adequate" | artefact_class == "marginal")

mucosa_list_included_not_in_mucosa <- mucosa_list_included %>%
  filter(!name %in% file_list_mucosa$image_fragment_mucosa_name)

mucosa_list_included_not_in_mapped_to_mucosa <- mucosa_list_included %>%
  filter(!name %in% file_list_map_to_mucosa$image_fragment_mucosa_name)
```
